svg.title: Workflow: Apparel retail AI transformation
svg.desc: Solution workflow (scheduled/batch) for Apparel retail AI transformation: 1 trigger: Scheduled sync (daily by default, intraday where needed, monthly for close packs) → source pulls; 2 system: Connectors pull read-only from ERP exports, DMS, POS, e-commerce, planning tool, HRMS and file drops, deltas only → staged data; 3 guardrail: Quality gate checks freshness, duplicates, missing keys and control totals → pass or block insights; 4 decision: Gate passed? yes → step 5 / no → insights blocked and data owner alerted; 5 system: Maps to the common grain (SKU, pack size, channel, month) in the knowledge graph with lineage and permissions → trusted base; 6 agent: Finance and planning agents run versioned rules for price bridge, COGS, forecast and plan vs actual; model explains, drafts → draft outputs; 7 human: Finance and planners approve key outputs at each gate → approved figures; 8 skill: Availability control tower raises debounced alerts with causes and next actions → exceptions; 9 system: Delivers via app, email, team chat, spreadsheet or PDF with data-as-of time; audit log and value ledger → governed delivery; 10 outcome: Automated explainable monthly close and earlier stock-out flags → time and working-capital gains
